title: UMD API technology research complete
body: Greenfield UMD API research. Findings in /workspace/Universeity/artifacts/designs/process/universal-media-decomposer-technology-research.md. Core: event-sourced semantic log (Postgres) = single authority; OCFL blobs; pgvector; durable jobs (Temporal/Hatchet+Dagster); buildable graph projection (Neo4j CE or relational-RCTE); per-modality extractor matrix (pysubs2, pandoc, ebooklib, PyMuPDF/pdfplumber, PaddleOCR/Tesseract, PyAV+ffmpeg, faster-whisper+pyannote, PySceneDetect); Vecalign alignment; splink entity resolution; Ollama/vLLM local + remote providers. Key find: Kuzu ARCHIVED (Apple) avoid; Memgraph disk-mode churn; AGE slow; Neo4j CE GPLv3 single-node. AGPL caveats: PyMuPDF, ebooklib, essentia. pyannote models gated. RDF 1.2 triple terms = provenance-on-statements.

title: Plan E amendment research: env-naming defect, app_factory/ready coverage, docs drift
body: Researched Plan E amendment targets. CONFIRMED: config.py:137-142 (env_prefix=UMD_ + env_nested_delimiter=__) is the invariant; canonical names UMD_POSTGRES__DSN / UMD_OCFL__ROOT / UMD_PROJECTION__VECTOR_HNSW_MIN_VERSION. Single-underscore names used at deploy/compose.yaml:23,24,29; .env.example:16,18-19,24,26; deploy/docker-entrypoint.sh:22; Makefile:19; docs/deployment.md:32; tests/test_api_contract.py:709 are silently ignored by pydantic-settings (extra=ignore) -> API falls back to default 127.0.0.1:5432/umd + ./.ocfl-root (wrong host / wrong volume). Alembic seam (migrations/env.py:24 + startup.py:63-64,179-180 + conftest.py:84-85) reads os.environ["UMD_POSTGRES_DSN"] directly (bypasses pydantic) and MUST be renamed in lockstep or dropped (cfg.set_main_option already carries URL). cli.py:22 migrate reads settings.postgres.dsn so container migrate ALSO targets default DSN. test_deployment_phaseE.py:116 asserts 'UMD_POSTGRES_DSN' in entrypoint -> renames break it unless updated. vector_hnsw_min_version setting (config.py:129) is DEAD: PgHNSWIndex (vector.py:37 PGVECTOR_MIN_VERSION, :242) + system.py:82 use default 0.8.2 constant; providers.md:33 claims configurability not delivered. Existing app_factory test (test_api_contract.py:702-721) monkeypatches wrong var (:709) and asserts only DB-agnostic /v1/health 200 + /v1/version -> silent false positive; /v1/ready assert :352 is (200,503) nondeterministic. Deterministic 503 path: paused checkpoint (pattern test_api_contract.py:232-240) -> /v1/ready raises ConsistencyLagError 503 code not_ready (system.py:58-72, errors.py:81-86), retryable, x-consistency rebuild-in-progress, retry-after 30.0; no record_503 metric (unlike guards). Docs: README.md:9-10,34 stale 380 (actual 411=406+4+1 at QA R2; 400 def test_ in 55 files); README.md:124 says 22 tables, tables.py defines 23; providers.md:36 Hatchet row lacks literal GATED (docs/README.md:56 requires). build_source_store (entrypoints.py:19-21) uses plain SourceStore(root=...) ctor (assumes initialized root; ignores settings.limits.upload caps). No ADR/ASR infra (opt-in, absent).
